steps.what: Analyze data to determine feasibility of the actual product proposal, checking original calculations, vessel constraints, uncertainty and trade-offs
Write and check the actual feasibility entry, reusing exact proposal and requirement references

tasks.design: Use explicit comparisons in {SPREADSHEET} to organise checked proposal evidence. The engineer determines actual feasibility and records it in {DOCS}; meeting a numerical requirement does not automatically establish a feasible marine design.

build_days.consent_and_access: 1-3 to inspect actual proposal and calculation access

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: explicit numerical requirement comparisons and exact reference reuse can support proposal assessment while engineering feasibility remains human.

assumptions: Representative proposal assessment using actual existing engineering calculations. Engineers produce those calculations in ordinary design work; focal source verification, mapping and comparison-rule capture are fully counted in s1. New simulation or test evidence is additional actual work if needed.

s1 supplies every value, unit, rule and reference used by s2. Missing or incompatible evidence returns to manual investigation. No clean new calculation feed or machine-inferred engineering criterion is assumed.

s3 retains source and calculation checking and actual feasibility judgement. s4 separately counts the actual working finding; only exact reference copying changes. Native tools come first; already automated comparisons and links have no new gain.

No proposal acceptance, design release, customer send or procurement action is hidden in the saved finding. Each actual formal action needs its real final version, authority and distinct action if included. Ordinary save is ungated with no author self-approval or saving.

Provisional shares ignore the prior. Gross 25+14*0.20=27.8; upkeep 4 leaves net 23.8. Retained s1,s3,s4 labour is 71.2 already counted. Save share 1 is the integer minimum for negligible effort, fully retained.
unknowns: Actual need for new test or simulation evidence
research_questions: Trace one marine product feasibility review from original calculations to the actual engineering conclusion.

already_counted.description: Source capture, original-evidence checking, feasibility judgement and actual finding writing remain in s1,s3,s4.

incremental.description: Maintain requirement mappings and comparison tests beyond ordinary feasibility checks.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Upper bound needs 25 points of manual numerical comparison and 2.8 reference-copying points. If native comparisons already cover 21 points, eligible gross is 4+2.8=6.8; 4 upkeep leaves 2.8. Fully native work needs a lower re-estimate.

inputs: Actual findings and design records in the engineering product-lifecycle system

assumptions: Representative problem-solving episode with an actual working change entry. Researchers and designers produce existing evidence and revisions during ordinary work; focal reading remains in s1 and actual joint work in s2. Research participants' real effort remains unchanged.

s2 counts actual discussion and decision capture, with no free transcript or machine-ready design feed. s3 separately counts actual writing and full checking; only references verified in s1 are reused. Missing or uncertain information requires real investigation.

Use native functionality first; existing views and links have no new gain. Do not invent meeting minutes or a post-conversation administrative report if the actual work produces no written change entry.

This working entry does not release a drawing, change a controlled design or issue implementation instructions. Actual formal changes need their real final-version authority and distinct action. Ordinary same-system save is ungated with no author self-approval or saving.

tasks.short: Compare ship work requests with historical costs

steps.what: Read actual ship work requests and completed-work records; verify and capture scope, quantities, dates, currencies, cost basis and comparison mapping
inputs: Completed work and cost records in the ship maintenance system
outputs: Checked requested and historical values with explicit comparable fields and rules

steps.what: Transfer exact checked work-request and previous ship-work values into the cost-review table
inputs: Checked values and mapping from s1
outputs: Cost-review table with original references and missing values flagged

steps.what: Calculate explicit quantity and cost differences on the human-specified comparable basis
outputs: Literal differences and non-comparable fields flagged

steps.what: Review work requests against previous completed ship work and original cost evidence; judge whether proposed costs are economically sound
inputs: Original requested and historical work evidence
Literal differences and actual scope limitations
outputs: Human economic-soundness judgement and unresolved questions

steps.what: Write and check the actual work-request review finding and supporting historical references
inputs: Actual human cost judgement and source evidence

tasks.design: Transfer checked ship work and cost records from {OPS_SYSTEM} into {SPREADSHEET} and calculate explicit comparable differences. The engineer assesses actual economic soundness and writes the review finding in {DOCS}; no work request is approved or purchased automatically.
tasks.previous_blocker: Requested and historical work values are recopied and literal differences calculated manually.
tasks.enabler_now: Explicit record mappings and comparison formulas can repeat those operations.
tasks.still_hard: Changed ship condition, scope, timing and cost basis can make a historical comparison misleading.
tasks.human_edge: Decide whether the comparison supports an economically sound request in its real context.

ambition.what: Review another relevant historical job when actual comparable records exist.

build_days.consent_and_access: 1-4 to inspect actual ship cost-record access

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: exact historical cost transfers and explicitly specified differences can assist work-request review while economic soundness and scope comparability remain human.

assumptions: Representative work-request cost review with actual prior ship-work records and a working review finding. Maintenance and cost staff produce source records in existing work; focal verification, scope comparison preparation and mapping are fully counted in s1.

s1 produces every value, currency, period convention and comparison rule consumed by s2-s3. Missing or non-comparable values return to manual investigation; no free normalised cost database, automatic inflation assumption or generated equivalent scope is assumed.

s4 retains original-source and arithmetic checking and actual economic judgement. s5 separately counts the real review entry, not an invented report after every discussion. Use native maintenance exports and spreadsheet formulas first; existing automation yields no new gain.

The review finding does not approve a work request, order parts, issue instructions, spend funds or send an external response. Any real action requires its actual final version, authority and distinct step if included. Ordinary same-system save is ungated with no author self-approval or saving.

Provisional shares ignore the prior. Gross 25+15=40; upkeep 4 leaves net 36. Retained s1,s4,s5 labour is 59 already counted. Save share 1 is the minimum integer representation of negligible effort and is fully retained.
unknowns: Existing native historical cost export and comparison tools
research_questions: Trace one ship work-request review to original completed-work records and separate literal comparison from economic judgement.

incremental.description: Maintain cost mappings and comparison rules beyond existing work-request review checks.
